Remind me, what caps the low end of the basefee. It can keep falling until 1 Wei right? 

And then from there back upward... 1 * 1.125 = 1.125.... Wei?

Or does it get stopped out at 4 Wei, because:
5 * 7/8=4.375 (round to 4 Wei)
4 * 7/8=3.5 (round to 4 Wei)
